detail.longDescription: I'm wondering about contacting someone who's involved with things like the Peak Finder app or similar. That likely uses a computer vision model and what is called "cross-view matching", where the elevation data from each pixel is translated into a ground-level view and vice versa. Edit to add that cross-view computer vision can be trained on a landscape like this with a relative handful of images (hundreds or less) and can geolocate the ground level viewpoint of a photo to within a handful of meters. Anyone have any connections with anyone working in the # ComputerVision # MachineLearning field? # OSINT # Geolocation # SAR
